note: C-15 / C-19 (deny by evidence): the AI door's slice, the default since C-19 (NML_CORE_SLICE=allow is the way back; the human door keeps the allow file until DS-109). A unit carrying a listed primitive (unit or weapon rule) stays on the table; every other rule the registry automates goes to the core. Unknown or unautomated rules stay refused in both modes. Measured in the 24-game shadow soak of 17.11. (wave1116/shadow_soak_C6.md); the list only shrinks.
unmapped_inert_why: A rule name no rules map knows for the unit's system and faction (an upgrade's own label such as Wandering Mystic, War Paint, Combat Shield): the registry gives neither side anything to read, and the rules the upgrade grants are carried and checked on their own.

inert.Unique: A list-building restriction only (army book); no effect on a volley.
inert.Army Standard Bearer: An upgrade's own label; the rules it grants (Fear(2)) are carried and checked on their own.
inert.Courage: The bare base the Courage Aura expansion stamps; no map entry on either side - the +1 morale rides the aura's own Banner entry.

deny_names.Grounded Protection: door omits the table's terrain trace (Grounded Protection) or once-per-game lines (Protection Feat), dlines_gap row 3; the roll, bypass and Warding gate lines are said since dlines2/3.
deny_names.Enhanced Knightborn: the table names the roll group by whichever of Knightborn / Enhanced Knightborn is live at the shot's distance (the gated Knightborn folds nothing within 9in); the core's group name is static, dlines_gap row 3.
deny_names.Protection Feat: door omits the table's terrain trace (Grounded Protection) or once-per-game lines (Protection Feat), dlines_gap row 3; the roll, bypass and Warding gate lines are said since dlines2/3.
deny_names.Surprise Attack: OD-H8 probe (core_ledger_lift_door_test.gd, 16 real AI activations, door on against door off): the activation-start burst rolls twice with the door on, the table's beat and then the core's own copy (16 / 16 seeds, the same shape as the pre-attack beats); refused by name until the table's beat or the core's copy steps aside. Teleport, Ethereal and plain Infiltrate read equal.

lifted_names.Regeneration Buff: same probe (ds/h_probe_beat_names.md); the table's free regeneration for the label is fixed (exact rule names, #3156)
lifted_names.Casting Buff: Utility Buff names probed through real AI activations, door on against off (ds/h_probe_beat_names.md): dice, end state and battle-log lines equal in three placements, the core ran every activation and the table's line named the rule; the beat is no double resolution for these.
lifted_names.Furious Buff: the table's pre-attack beat records the once-record after the capture and the door's landing spends it with the table's own spend (CoreActivation.land_late_once_records, #3201): real AI activations, door on against off, 2 placements x 8 seeds, dice, end state (records included) and every battle-log line equal, the core ran every activation (test/one_core/core_once_lift_door_test.gd)

pre_attack_beat_twice.why: Shooter side only (`side`: a beat is the bearer's own act; 77 of 77 beat names probed as a TARGET are equal, 6 seeds each, ds/h_probe_beat_targets.md, once the table's Regeneration Buff prefix read is fixed). The table resolves a bearer's pre-attack beat in main.gd before the volley, and the core, which takes the whole activation, resolves it again from the board it captured before that beat. Measured 19.11. (one real AI activation per seed, deny slice, door on against door off, 8 seeds each): Mend 8/8 and Breath Attack 8/8 roll the beat's die twice (a second Blast volley on 7/8), Mind Control (also Fatigue Debuff) 8/8 rolls its morale test twice, Storm Attack 8/8 rolls its trigger dice twice, Reckless Piercing 8/8 rolls its die twice, and the Utility Buff family leaves a stale once-record or marker behind on the table 8/8 (Precision Shooter Buff: a record the core already spent; Precision Tag: a tag marker). H-5 (Plan H): Mend left the group - the beats guard in main.gd hands a Mend bearer's beat to the core's one call, which lands the heal and says the line (H-5a; core_beats_guard_test). H-6: Breath Attack left the same way (the core says the fizzle / breath lines and lands the wounds). H-7: Storm Attack left the same way (the core says the storm line and lands each success's wounds; the once-per-game latch returns in the delta, `storm_used`). H-8: Mind Control and Fatigue Debuff (primitive Mind Control) left the same way (the core says the test, FATIGUED, stays-put and moved lines; the shift and Shaken land through the delta). The family is one primitive, so its Casting Buff, Precision Target and Precision Spotter (each measured equal, 8/8) and Re-Position Artillery (not measured) go with it. Piercing Tag, Piercing Target and Piercing Spotter (primitive Piercing Tag) run in the same slot but measured equal 8/8 and stay taken (LD-6).

unpredictable_die_without_weapon_in_reac.why: The core throws the volley's Unpredictable die before any weapon fires, off the first shooter, even when no weapon of the shooter reaches the target; the table fires nothing then and rolls nothing (Zairetia's 12 in gun at the sweep's 14 in: 16 of 16 seeds differ, with or without the Versatile pick, for `Unpredictable Shooter` and the generic `Unpredictable`; in reach both halves are equal, 16 of 16). Gate 12 (21.11.) found 20 taken sweep volleys unequal once epoch 94 and #3148 lifted the guards it had hidden behind (the Versatile pair, the Experimental Tinctures name). Refused by primitive for the SHOOTER only (a die-bearing target is taken, equal). Wider than the difference: the in-reach volleys of a bearer stay on the table too, because the slice cannot see the reach.
unpredictable_die_without_weapon_in_reac.leaves_with: the core throwing the die only for a volley in which a weapon fires (lane unpred)

door_omits_simultaneous_fire_line.why: A shooter with a Deadly weapon beside another ranged weapon (its joined heroes' included): the table lands Deadly inline, so a later weapon sees fewer models and says `Simultaneous fire: ...` or Blast's cap read when the volley started; the core lands after the dice and writes neither. Not a rule name: `CoreSlice` refuses it by predicate (`deadly_beside_other_weapons`), switched on by this group. Measured 19.11.: 29 volleys, dlines_gap row 18.
door_omits_simultaneous_fire_line.leaves_with: the dlines2 train that lands Deadly inline on the step path

door_own_shred_beside_alias.why: A weapon's own Shred beside a unit-level Shred rule of another name (Warbound, Destroyer, Infected, ...) is two rules in the table (R-1 A2: each pays its extra wounds, the alias gated by distance); the core pays the unmodified 1s once, so the target's wounds differ (5 of 12 seeds, dlines3 door test). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice` refuses it by predicate (`own_shred_beside_alias`), switched on by this group; a state difference, so the dice-only pin keeps it.
door_own_shred_beside_alias.leaves_with: the core paying the own part and the alias part apart (R-1 A2 on the step path)

door_omits_fortified_aura_loss_line.why: An aofs / gff aura-granted Fortified (Fortified Aura, Guardian Boost Aura; Gleaming Armour carries Fortified Aura) is a Fortified-primitive entry with `lost_if_bearer_killed`: when the bearer (the unit or a joined hero) has fallen the table stands the benefit down and says `<aura>: bearer killed -> benefit lost` once, guarded across volleys. The core stands the bare Fortified down on the same dice but writes no line (probe 16 of 16, line only); for the alias walk (Guardian Boost) it keeps the benefit, so the dice differ (defense 5+ against the table's 6+, 16 of 16). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice` refuses a TARGET in that state (`fortified_aura_bearer_dead`), switched on by this group. A live bearer and the gf / aof Aura Channel spelling are equal and taken. Probed 20.11. (ds/h14_probe_fortified_aura.md).
door_omits_fortified_aura_loss_line.leaves_with: the core reading the alias loss and carrying the once-guard with its line (an epoch: the alias dice change)

door_versatile_pick_modified_to_hit.why: The table latches a Versatile Attack pick (+1 to hit or AP(+1)) on the MODIFIED to-hit number of the activation's first volley; the core's latch reads the plain Quality (`sim::versatile_latch`, its `hit_target`). When a to-hit modifier is in play (Artillery, a Stealth or Evasive family rule, Aircraft on the target; Artillery, a Shot Modifier, Instinctive on the shooter) the two can pick differently and the dice and the target's wounds differ (door probe, Vinci Tech Quality 4 AP(1) at Defense 3+: 12 of 12 seeds against Stealth, Evasive and Artillery, 8 of 12 with a different end state; 3000 pts roster sweep: 6 volleys). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice.pair_refusals` refuses the PAIR, switched on by this group; a state difference, so the dice-only pin keeps it.
door_versatile_pick_modified_to_hit.leaves_with: the Versatile latch reading the volley's modified to-hit number instead of the plain Quality

door_takedown_names_an_equipment_carrier.why: The table names the picked model of a Takedown by its label (`_solo_model_label`): Tough(X) model, the last of several weapons, else the model's FIRST ITEM (`Takedown (<w>): targets the Banner in <U>`); the core carries only an item count per model, so it writes `trooper`. Measured in a door test (Takedown at a unit with one Banner carrier: 12 of 12 seeds differ). Not a rule name: `CoreSlice.pair_refusals` refuses a Takedown shooter at a target with a living item-carrying model, switched on by this group.
door_takedown_names_an_equipment_carrier.leaves_with: the capture carrying the item NAMES of a model's kit
